html:
G'oya

"Agar A bo'lsa, B" ko'rinishidagi qoida CHECK da NOT A OR B deb yoziladi. "Chegirma faqat VIP'da" bu "VIP bo'lmasa, chegirma 0", ya'ni type = 'vip' OR discount = 0. Kompaniya qoidasi ikki yo'nalishli: korporativda bor, boshqalarda yo'q. Har yo'nalish alohida CHECK.

Yechim

CREATE TABLE clients (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'oddiy' CHECK (type IN ('oddiy', 'vip', 'korporativ')),
  discount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discount BETWEEN 0 AND 30),
  company TEXT,
  CHECK (type = 'vip' OR discount = 0),
  CHECK (type = 'korporativ' OR company IS NULL),
  CHECK (type <> 'korporativ' OR company IS NOT NULL)
)

Namunada Bekzod oddiy mijoz, unga 10% berib bo'lmaydi. Jasur korporativ, lekin kompaniyasi yo'q. Malikani oddiyga o'tkazish faqat ikkinchi urinishda o'tdi, chunki u yerda chegirma ham shu buyruqda 0 qilingan.

Tuzoqlar

"Chegirma faqat VIP'da" ni "VIP'da chegirma bo'lishi shart" deb o'qish oson. Unda chegirmasiz VIP rad etiladi:

Noto'g'riCREATE TABLE clients (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'oddiy' CHECK (type IN ('oddiy', 'vip', 'korporativ')),
  discount INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discount BETWEEN 0 AND 30),
  company TEXT,
  CHECK (type = 'vip' AND discount > 0 OR type <> 'vip' AND discount = 0),
  CHECK (type = 'korporativ' OR company IS NULL),
  CHECK (type <> 'korporativ' OR company IS NOT NULL)
)

NOT NULL siz discount qoidani teshib qo'yadi: NULL chegirma bilan type = 'vip' OR discount = 0 oddiy mijozda noma'lum bo'ladi, CHECK esa uni o'tkazadi.

Boshqa yo'l

Ikki yo'nalishli qoidani bitta CHECK da mantiqiy qiymatlarni solishtirib yozish mumkin: CHECK ((type = 'korporativ') = (company IS NOT NULL)). Ikkala bazada ishlaydi, chunki type hech qachon NULL emas. Ikki alohida CHECK esa o'qishga osonroq, xato xabarida ham qaysi qoida buzilgani ko'rinadi.
